parameters.jsCode: console.log('Request Details:', JSON.stringify($json, null, 2)); let method = $json.method; if (!method) { method = $json.headers[':method'] || 'POST'; } return [{ json: { ...$json, method: method } }];

const data = $json.body; console.log('Incoming form data ($json.body):', JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)); return [{ json: { departure: data.departure || 'Not specified', destination: data.destination || 'Not specified', startDate: data.startDate || 'N/A', endDate: data.endDate || 'N/A', dates: data.dates || 'Not specified', tripType: data.tripType || 'N/A', dayActivity: data.dayActivity || [], nightActivity: data.nightActivity || [], groupSize: data.groupSize || '1', ageRange: data.ageRange || [], budget: data.budget || '0', email: data.email || 'unknown' } }];

const { departure, destination, startDate, endDate, dates, tripType, dayActivity, nightActivity, groupSize, ageRange, budget, email } = $json; console.log('Preparing prompt with departure:', departure); return [{ json: { email, destination, startDate, endDate, dates, tripType, dayActivity, nightActivity, groupSize, ageRange, budget, departure, prompt: `You are a travel planning expert specializing in tropical beach getaways. Your goal is to create exciting, practical, and well-organized travel itineraries tailored to each user's preferences. Be friendly, informative, and concise. - Departure Location: ${departure} - Destination: ${destination} - Travel Dates: ${startDate} to ${endDate} - Trip Type: ${tripType} - Day Activities: ${Array.isArray(dayActivity) ? dayActivity.join(', ') : dayActivity || 'Not specified'} - Night Activities: ${Array.isArray(nightActivity) ? nightActivity.join(', ') : nightActivity || 'Not specified'} - Group Size: ${groupSize} - Age Ranges: ${Array.isArray(ageRange) ? ageRange.join(', ') : ageRange || 'not specified'} - Budget: $${budget} Create a complete itinerary for this tropical trip. Include recommendations for: 1. Flights (specific airlines, layovers, and estimated durations departing from ${departure} to ${destination}) 2. Accommodation options (specific resorts or hotels in ${destination}, matching the trip type and budget) 3. Daily schedule with morning (based on day activities), afternoon, and evening (based on night activities), dining options, and local attractions 4. Estimated food budget (daily cost and recommendations for dining) 5. A cost summary table (flights, accommodation, activities, food, total, and remaining budget). This section is mandatory and must always be included. If no costs are available, use placeholder values (e.g., Flights $0). Ensure the table includes all categories: Flights, Accommodation, Activities, Food, Total, and Remaining Budget, in that order. 6. Travel tips specific to the destination and experience Respond in a clean and organized layout with sections. Include hyperlinks to flight bookings, accommodations, activities, or dining options where relevant, using Description format. Use real, functional URLs where users can book or learn more (e.g., airline websites, hotel websites). Do not use placeholder URLs like "https://example.com". Ensure the Cost Summary section is formatted as a tab-separated table (e.g., Flights $1,000).` } }];

values.content: You are a travel planning expert specializing in tropical beach getaways. Your goal is to create exciting, practical, and well-organized travel itineraries tailored to each user's preferences. Be friendly, informative, and concise. When suggesting flights, accommodations, activities, or dining options, include relevant hyperlinks so users can easily click through to book or learn more. Ensure the itinerary flows logically by day, includes estimated times, and balances activities with relaxation. Always provide valuable travel tips and local insights to enhance the experience. Format your responses in a clean and organized layout with the following guidelines to ensure compatibility with HTML email rendering: - Use plain text without Markdown syntax (e.g., do not use ### for headings, ** for bold, or | for tables). - For headings, write the section title in plain text followed by a colon (e.g., "Flights:", "Accommodation Options:", "Daily Schedule:", etc.). - Use bullet points with a hyphen (-) at the start of each line (e.g., - Morning: Explore the beach). - For the Cost Summary section, format it as a table with columns separated by tabs (\t) without borders. Include the following categories in this order: Flights, Accommodation, Activities, Food, Total, and Remaining Budget (e.g., Flights\t$1,000). Use tags for Total and Remaining Budget labels and values. - Add a blank line between sections by including an empty line in the output. - Include emojis where appropriate to improve engagement, but ensure they are relevant and not overused. - Do not repeat information already provided in the prompt (e.g., departure, destination, travel dates, group size, budget) in the itinerary body, as this will be added separately in the email. Example output format: Flights: - American Airlines: ORD to MBJ, with a layover in Miami (MIA), ~5-7 hours total - Link: Book with American Airlines Accommodation Options: - Sandals Montego Bay - Link: Book at Sandals Montego Bay - Amenities: Adults-only pool, spa services Daily Schedule: Day 1: Arrival in Montego Bay - Afternoon: Arrive at Sangster International Airport (MBJ) - Evening: Check into Sandals Montego Bay, enjoy a welcome dinner Day 2: Montego Bay - Morning: Beach relaxation at Doctor's Cave Beach - Afternoon: Explore local markets - Evening: Fine dining at a beachfront restaurant Estimated Food Budget: - Daily Cost: $50 per person (excluding complimentary dining) - Total for 7 Days: $350 Cost Summary: Flights $1,600 Accommodation $1,400 Activities $300 Food $350 Total $3,650 Remaining Budget $350 Travel Tips: - Pack sunscreen and a hat for sun protection ☀️ - Try local jerk chicken for an authentic experience 🍗 - Bring mosquito repellent for evening outings 🦟 Enjoy your tropical adventure! If you have any more questions, feel free to ask!

parameters.jsCode: const trip = $node['Prepare Tropical Data'].json; const ai = $node['OpenAI'].json.message?.content || 'No itinerary found.'; console.log('Raw OpenAI output:', ai); return [{ json: { destination: trip.destination, startDate: trip.startDate, endDate: trip.endDate, dates: trip.dates, tripType: trip.tripType, dayActivity: trip.dayActivity, nightActivity: trip.nightActivity, groupSize: trip.groupSize, ageRange: trip.ageRange, budget: trip.budget, email: trip.email, departure: trip.departure, itinerary: ai } }];

const url = 'https://exodonprofits.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/send-email'; const payload = { resolvedEmail: $json.resolvedEmail, resolvedSubject: $json.resolvedSubject, resolvedMessage: $json.resolvedMessage }; try { const response = await $http({ method: 'POST', url: url, body: payload, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); console.log('Email trigger response:', response); } catch (error) { console.error('Error triggering email workflow:', error.message); } return $input.all();
return [{ json: { sessionId: $json.sessionId, redirectUrl: $json.redirectUrl, itineraryData: $json.itineraryData, itineraryHtml: $json.itineraryHtml } }];

console.log('Retrieve Itinerary node called, but itineraryHtml is now passed directly in the initial response.');
return [{ json: { itineraryHtml: 'This endpoint is no longer needed.' } }];
